info.title: Ricky API
info.description: REST API for one Ricky organization: contacts, conversations, messages, templates, workflows and webhooks. Requests and responses are JSON with snake_case fields; IDs are UUIDs except template IDs; times are ISO 8601 in UTC.

ResponsesReport.description: How fast people and AI agents answer customers. A response is the first message sent to the customer, other than a reaction, right after a customer message that is not a reaction; its response time is the wait since that customer message. Later messages in a row are follow-ups, and automations and templates are not responses. Responses are dated when they were sent. Conversation openings, closes and assignments play no part.
